name: tech-survivor
description: Tech Survivor - Technical Event Platform (MCQ Qualification + Coding Challenge)

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace packages/types && npm run build --workspace packages/config && npm run build --workspace packages/shared
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n "api,web" -c "blue,magenta" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspace backend && npm run typecheck --workspace frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace scripts
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace backend && npm run lint --workspace frontend
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspace packages/shared && npm run test --workspace backend
